approval_target.description: Immediately preceding assistant structural-model response to: now show me how is the structural model, what is a tenant, user, layers
approval_target.association_posture: inferred from adjacent conversation; raw approval is explicit

principal.identity: trusted issuer, subject and principal kind

approved_model.user: human principal; may belong to multiple tenants
approved_model.service_principal: machine principal with its own credentials and permissions
approved_model.tenant: flat isolation boundary for membership, permissions, configuration and request data; no parent/child inheritance
approved_model.membership: trusted principal-to-tenant relationship; membership alone grants no inference permission
approved_model.session: revocable authenticated continuity; does not itself grant permissions
approved_model.role: grouping of permissions activated through the authorization model
approved_model.permission: exact resource, action and tenant scope
approved_model.replay_visibility: principal-private within tenant; current authorization required
approved_model.model_alias: public offering distinct from private provider deployment, URL and credentials

layers.name: client
layers.owns: presentation, tenant selection, API requests and results

layers.name: authentication
layers.owns: credential verification and authenticated identity/session validation

layers.name: authorization
layers.owns: current membership, sessions, active roles and exact permission evaluation

layers.name: application policy
layers.owns: routes, permission requirements, discovery filtering, selection, mappings, stream/replay policy

layers.name: runtime adapters
layers.owns: HTTP, secrets, clocks, bytes, storage and execution of compiled contracts
